title: Backend Developer (Mobile APIs)
text:
Demo Co. Spruce is a scale-up building fitness apps. We are looking for a mid-level Backend Developer (Mobile APIs) to join our mobile team. Work is two office days a week in Brightwater Bay.

Our stack: kotlin, python, go, java. You will ship features end to end, work closely with design and product and review code with the team.

Regular hack days.
